headline: Gate D second half (chemical heredity & selection, Option B inherited NETWORK COMPOSITION — NOT template copying): verdict=qualified. Fitness is grounded in the real study-32/33 coupling (composition -> membrane retention -> standing pool -> division rate), so selection acts on a trait with a real mechanistic fitness consequence. Across 8 seeds x 40 generations at equal feeds: an inherited composition difference yields a reproducible parent-offspring FITNESS correlation (mean +0.949) far above the matched no-inheritance null (-0.018; permutation p=0.0001), AND the inheriting population SHIFTS composition under selection (mean shift +0.551 toward higher-retention / longer-chain) while the null drifts (-0.004; p=0.0002). So there IS selectable chemical heredity on the compositional-inheritance first cut; the vasas-2010 evolvability caveat was TESTED (sigma=0.03, not tuned) and the population shifts rather than drifts. Qualified because inheritance is compositional (Option B); template copying (Option A, og-34a) is the higher-fidelity follow-on. Metabolism = sustained A1 network, NOT autocatalytic (A2 refuted).
